reviewer: Astra independent Berkeley EE appointment review
independence: Only person_id, name, profile_url and original_title read from parent roster. Parent category, included and decision fields not inspected. All list/profile facts obtained afresh from official sources.
policy: Website-defined regular research EE membership: official EE and current list intersection, with explicit role and future start exclusions. Non-courtesy joint EE and in-residence research faculty included. Below-line affiliates, adjunct, teaching, emeritus, retired and incoming separate. No topic filter or FTE inference.

coverage.scope_limit: Complete against official EE list, current list and EE-current list at observation, not an HR census. Classified source conflicts preserved; generic current-list membership alone does not prove current regular role.
